model_correction_this_round.what: the composition of quality and trait bonuses
model_correction_this_round.old: multiplier = quality_factor * (1 + trait_bonus), so a Tier I emblem scored 0.10 of its stat
model_correction_this_round.new: multiplier = 1 + quality_bonus + net_trait_bonus, exactly as the client prints it
model_correction_this_round.evidence: all nine observed emblems reproduce to the digit; the old rule reproduced none
model_correction_this_round.consequence: the real multiplier range is about 1.1 to 2.6 rather than 0.09 to 3.15, so a banner reweights the stats far less violently than the pre-banner model assumed

action_taken_since: Roll tokens spent from 38 to 6 rerolling the Core and Support banners and one Mid slot. Stats are unchanged on all nine slots; only qualities and traits moved. Teams and Coach unchanged.
resolved_this_round: Banner and token balance re-synced from screenshots.

stat_reroll_outcome_distribution.why: Tier-1 guarantees only that a reroll produces a NEW stat and that a banner carries no duplicate stats. It says nothing about the probabilities. Every stat-reroll EV computed so far assumed a uniform draw, which is an assumption, not evidence.
stat_reroll_outcome_distribution.note: The three green-stat operations currently on the board are therefore not recommended.

support_watchers_gap.breakpoint: Xtreme's support pair would need between 1.95 and 3.38 MORE watchers per series than LGD's (depending on the coach suffix) for KEEP to beat CHANGE.
support_watchers_gap.why_it_blocks: That range sits inside the plausible spread of team behaviour, and there is no public player-level source for Watchers Taken, so the sign of the comparison cannot be established. The switch is not recommended on a model that cannot see one of the three slots it is scoring.
